sources.label: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors, Admin 0 - Countries
sources.notice: None required: the data are in the public domain and the credit is optional.

constants.dlonFormula: dlat / cos(radians(31.28)): 10 km of longitude at 31.28 N
constants.idPattern: jo-rRRcCC (RR = row, CC = col, two digits each)
constants.bounds: s = south + row * dlat, n = south + (row + 1) * dlat, w = west + col * dlon, e = west + (col + 1) * dlon (degrees, not rounded)
constants.centre: lat = south + (row + 0.5) * dlat, lon = west + (col + 0.5) * dlon, rounded to 6 decimals
constants.inclusion: a box is kept when its centre (6 decimals) is inside the Natural Earth 10m v5.1.1 Jordan polygon (even-odd ray casting in longitude/latitude)
constants.inJordan: share of the box inside the polygon, 0 to 1, 4 decimals: exact clipping of the polygon by the box in longitude/latitude; 1 only when the boundary does not touch the box (a touching box shows at most 0.9999)
constants.borderKm: distance from the box centre to the nearest point of the polygon boundary, km, 2 decimals (local equirectangular projection, R = 6,371,008.8 m)
constants.pointToBox: row = floor((lat - south) / dlat), col = floor((lon - west) / dlon)

coverage.rule: every point of a 0.02 deg lattice (multiples of 0.02 deg) inside the polygon is in a kept box or within 14.2 km of the border

area.rule: sum over all grid cells of (share inside x cell area) equals the polygon area within 0.1 %

extent.rule: the polygon's area outside the grid is under 1 km2
